title: SERVER-CHECKS-1: the server runs the required checks and posts the commit status, so no PR depends on Actions or on a code agent
body:
**Owner:** Staff (platform)
**Trigger:** every tick, for each open PR with a HANDOFF item
**Done check:** grep:seed/worker/src/checks.js::postCommitStatus
**Status:** closed

Found 2026-11-14: every GitHub Actions job is refused in about 3 seconds (billing), so required checks never pass, the sweeper's merge-when-clean never fires, and the only way a PR merged was a local code agent running scripts/local_checks.py and merging by hand: a code agent babysitting the loop (CODE-AGENT-SOP-1 forbids it). The tick Worker must run checks.yml itself: a Cloudflare Sandbox (or container) clones the PR head, runs scripts/local_checks.py --json, and the Worker posts the verdict as the required commit status through the GitHub App token; the sweeper then merges on clean. Closing probe: a HANDOFF item closes with no code-agent session open and the PR's statuses show context checks from ultrastable-tick.

**Disposition:** shelved (ttl, 2026-11-21T18:12:26Z, DISPOSE-1)

**Evidence:** open 156.9 hours (limit 6 hours) and no loop closed it (SLA-8H-1). Its closing probe still runs on every fleet pass and records `fixed` when it passes; the executor retries it when its open queue is empty (every 30 days at most).
